name: MusicPromo
one_liner: A dead-simple mobile tool that turns a photo and audio clip into a short promo video for social media, then helps artists present that work through public MusicPromo artist profiles.

tech_stack.video_rendering: On-device via renderer abstraction (shared template composition; FFmpeg active backend via ffmpeg-kit-react-native-alt alias; remotion-local feature-flag path currently falls back to FFmpeg until native runtime + quality gates pass; beta watermark export uses drawtext only when supported)

personas.name: Indie Artist / Creator
personas.description: Independent musician or content creator self-promoting on Instagram, TikTok, etc.

personas.name: Venue / Promoter / Booker
personas.description: Someone searching for artists or DJs to book for shows, parties, venue nights, or local opportunities.

personas.name: Small Label / Publisher
personas.description: Record label or publishing company creating promo for a roster of artists.

north_star: Number of videos exported/downloaded; post-v1 discovery adds qualified public artist profile views as a secondary north star

entities.storage: Convex metadata + cloud media storage TBD

design_reference: Meta's Edits app (Instagram companion). Dual theme: light for browsing, dark for editing.

implementation_references.name: Togetherly
implementation_references.purpose: Reference Nick's prior online app-layer implementation for Convex-backed state, route organization, public/interactive surfaces, and profile-like data flows before implementing Phase 7. Adapt compatible patterns only; do not copy product-specific assumptions.

epics.name: iOS Native Surface + Liquid Glass Adoption

open_questions: Can a true native Remotion on-device renderer path be shipped in this Expo architecture without cloud rendering?
When running the Phase 4 gates on target devices, does the remotion-local path meet speed, sync, stability, and parity requirements?
Which iOS native UI components should ship behind Phase 5 flags first to maximize UX impact while preserving Android fallback parity?
What minimum template primitive set should be standardized to speed up new template authoring?
Verify Clerk supports anonymous sessions in React Native SDK
Verify soft-delete satisfies Apple's account deletion requirement
Expo + FFmpeg-kit compatibility — spike in Phase 0
Which cloud media storage provider should host public showcase videos and thumbnails?
Which Togetherly online-app patterns should MusicPromo reuse, and which should be intentionally ignored because MusicPromo is a mobile Expo app with different product constraints?
Should public artist profile routes use handles, immutable user IDs, or both?
What profile fields are required before an artist can publish publicly?
Should Search be available to signed-out users, guest users, or only signed-in users in the first slice?
What minimum moderation/reporting workflow is required before public media is allowed?
